Demultiplex and trim tags and primers (no reverse strand check)

Source: R/vtamR_fun.R
demultiplex_and_trim_strand_plus.Rd

Same as demultiplex_and_trim_fasta, but without checking the reverse-complement of the sequences. Demultiplex each input FASTA file using tag combinations located at the extremities of merged reads, then trim primer sequences.

Usage

demultiplex_and_trim_strand_plus(
  fastainfo,
  fasta_dir,
  outdir,
  cutadapt_path = NULL,
  num_threads = 0,
  tag_to_end = T,
  primer_to_end = T,
  cutadapt_error_rate = 0.1,
  cutadapt_minimum_length = 50,
  cutadapt_maximum_length = 500,
  sep = ",",
  compress = F,
  quiet = T
)

Arguments

fastainfo

Data frame or path to a CSV file with the following columns: tag_fw, primer_fw, tag_rv, primer_rv, sample, sample_type (mock/negative/real), habitat (optional), replicate, fasta.

fasta_dir

Character string specifying the directory containing input FASTA files (listed in the fasta column of fastainfo).

outdir

Character string specifying the output directory.

cutadapt_path

Optional path to the cutadapt executable. If NULL (default), resolved via getOption("vtamR.cutadapt_path") or the PATH (see get_path).

num_threads

Positive integer specifying the number of CPU threads to use. If 0, all available CPUs are used.

tag_to_end

Logical. If TRUE, tags are assumed to be located at the extremities of reads (starting at the first base).

primer_to_end

Logical. If TRUE, primers are assumed to follow directly after tags (i.e., no heterogeneity spacer).

cutadapt_error_rate

Numeric value between 0 and 1 specifying the maximum allowed error rate between primers and reads (exact match is required for tags).

cutadapt_minimum_length

Positive integer specifying the minimum length of trimmed sequences.

cutadapt_maximum_length

Positive integer specifying the maximum length of trimmed sequences.

sep

Character string specifying the field separator used in input and output CSV files.

compress

Logical. If TRUE, compress output files using gzip.

quiet

Logical. If TRUE, suppress informational messages and only display warnings or errors.

Value

Data frame corresponding to the output sampleinfo.csv file and one FASTA file per tag combination for each input FASTA file, containing trimmed reads.

Details

Input files can be compressed or uncompressed. Output compression is controlled by compress.

The output sampleinfo.csv file is similar to the input fastainfo file, but without tag and primer columns.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
fastainfo_df <- demultiplex_and_trim_strand_plus(
  fastainfo = fastainfo_df,
  fasta_dir = "data/fasta",
  outdir = "data/sorted",
  tag_to_end = TRUE,
  primer_to_end = TRUE,
  cutadapt_minimum_length = 300,
  cutadapt_maximum_length = 350,
  sep = ","
)
} # }
